study type: Secondary analysis of a longitudinal study
exposure: Childbirth education (none, single-session, 2-session, 3 or more sessions)
Number of childbirth education sessions attended
outcome: Use of pain medication during labor
finding: Attending 3 or more childbirth education sessions was associated with a decreased risk of planned cesarean delivery and increased shared decision-making, while any childbirth education was associated with lower odds of using pain medication and planned Cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Attending 3 or more childbirth education sessions was associated with a decreased risk of planned cesarean delivery.
